name: Duskwood Corvette

items.name: Stealthy
items.text: Due to its ebony coloration, a duskwood corvette is difficult to detect under certain conditions. It is Concealed in dim light.

items.name: Weapon Mounts
items.text: This vehicle has 2 weapon mounts, one on each side of the vehicle. At purchase, these weapon mounts are initially empty. Installing or uninstalling a weapon into a mount requires 1 day, a successful DC 28 Crafting check check, and an appropriate weapon. The weapon mounts can be equipped with Huge or smaller ranged siege weapons.

text: This triple-masted warship is crafted mainly from sturdy duskwood brought down from Andoran's Darkmoon Vale. Naval captains must prove their worth before securing a post on such a valuable vessel.
